decisions.reason: The two-component resin injection unit draws directly on the firm's core plural-component pumping and metering expertise, so it can read early market feedback and refine the product in-house.
This second resin injection unit also builds on established plural-component knowledge, although overlap with Product A slightly raises the chance of consolidation.
Automatic airless spray guns sit squarely within the firm's long-standing airless spray know-how and in-house manufacturing, which gives it high absorptive capacity for improving them.
Manual airless guns are a core accessory line that relies on the firm's existing engineering and service knowledge, and they support sales of its pump systems.
Air-assisted airless technology is a close extension of the firm's airless spray expertise, so the firm can readily assimilate customer feedback on it.

The data logger relies on electronics and software knowledge that is less central to a mechanical equipment maker, but it complements the coating equipment and fits the firm's push toward application technology, so it is worth keeping while the firm builds that competence.
